title: Audit log line sent to an external receiver
description: One JSONL line (file) or the MSG field of an RFC 5424 message (syslog over TLS, RFC 5425). Only audit_events metadata: record texts, titles, queries (query_text), tokens and passwords are never sent. details contains only the allowlisted keys below. Lines form a chain: h = sha256(prev ‖ canonical line without h), prev is the previous line’s h (64 zeros for the first line). The edge and the bridge write the same format; contracts/edge/ references this schema.

seq.description: Line number at this receiver; increases without gaps (audit_ship_state.seq)

prev.description: Previous line’s h; 64 zeros for the first line

h.description: sha256(prev ‖ canonical line without the h field): keys sorted alphabetically, no spaces

id.description: audit_events.id: the receiver uses it to identify duplicates

source.description: Sender: gateway (inner-perimeter audit log), edge, bridge

on_behalf_of.description: Person profile identifier, not a login

records.description: Number of affected records, without identifiers

details.description: Allowlist: all other event details are discarded when building the line

key.description: Setting name (category.key) or API key identifier, without its value

exception.description: The exception under which the local administrator acknowledged a high or page alert (op alert_ack)
